verdict.rationale: An auth framework could plausibly ship event hooks or triggers, so this axis applies. The evidence pack never documents user-definable rules that fire actions on events such as sign-up or session creation. The closest items are adjacent: per-path rate-limit rules, the built-in auto sign-in after sign-up, and an activity-feed graphic, and none of these is a user-defined event-to-action rule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
